settings.title: "White glove" isn't a regulated term. Here's what it means at Curtis.

settings.editor: Any mover can put the phrase on a truck. The difference shows up in who packs the art, who hangs the chandelier, and what happens to the pieces that aren't ready to go into the new house yet.

settings.title_text: Packed by people who know antiques
settings.description_text: Crews are matched to the job. Collections, antiques and art get packers who handle them every week — with custom crating for the pieces that shouldn't ride in a box.

settings.title_text: We finish the room, not just the move
settings.description_text: Art and mirrors hung, chandeliers installed, furniture placed where it belongs, boxes unpacked and taken away. The move ends when the room is finished.
Between houses or during a renovation, pieces go into climate-controlled storage and are individually catalogued, so what comes back out is exactly what went in.

tabs.tab_content: White glove moving is full-service moving for high-value and fragile belongings. At Curtis Specialized Moving & Storage in Dallas, that means expert packing and custom crating, careful transport, placement in the new home, and finishing work like hanging art and installing chandeliers, plus climate-controlled storage if needed.

tabs.tab_title: How is white glove moving different from a regular move?
tabs.tab_content: A regular move ends when the boxes are inside. A white glove move with Curtis in Dallas continues until the room is finished: furniture placed, boxes unpacked and removed, art and mirrors hung, and chandeliers installed. Fragile, antique and high-value pieces are packed and crated individually.

tabs.tab_title: Do you move and install fine art and chandeliers?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Curtis Specialized Moving & Storage moves fine art, antiques, statuary and tapestries, and hangs and installs art, mirrors and chandeliers in Dallas–Fort Worth homes. Fragile and high-value pieces receive custom crating, and crystal chandeliers can be cleaned during installation.

tabs.tab_title: Can you store my furniture and art between homes?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Curtis offers climate-controlled storage in Dallas for furniture, fine art and valuables. Each item is individually catalogued and inspected, so pieces can be held safely during a renovation or between closings and delivered when the new home is ready.

tabs.tab_title: What areas do your white glove movers serve?
tabs.tab_content: Curtis Specialized Moving & Storage is based at 460 W Mockingbird Lane in Dallas and serves the Dallas–Fort Worth area, including Highland Park, University Park, Preston Hollow, Plano, Frisco, Southlake, Arlington and Fort Worth. Long-distance, interstate and international moves are also available.

tabs.tab_title: How much does white glove moving cost in Dallas?
tabs.tab_content: White glove moving costs depend on the size of the home, how many pieces need crating or installation, and whether storage is needed. Curtis provides the time, cost and services up front after a private consultation, and published rates are on the curtisms.com pricing page.
